mainEntity.name: What types of wall paneling are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. can install various wall paneling types, including wood panels (solid, veneer, or engineered), MDF panels, PVC panels, and decorative composite options. The best choice depends on your desired aesthetic, durability needs, and budget. For instance, solid wood offers classic elegance but requires more maintenance, while MDF provides a smooth finish suitable for painting at a lower cost. We help you evaluate material properties like moisture resistance and impact durability, which are crucial for areas like kitchens or high-traffic hallways.
